Privacy Notice

What we collect

We collect the email address you sign up with, the content you post, and basic technical data such as browser type and the pages you visit in our service.

How we use it

We use this information to run the service, keep it secure, and send you messages about your account. We do not sell personal data.

Sharing

We share data with service providers who host our systems, and when the law requires it. Each provider may only use data to work for us.

Retention

We keep account data until you delete your account, then remove it within 30 days, except where the law requires us to keep records.

Children

The service is not meant for children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.

Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data by writing to privacy@acme-example.test.
